title: Mobile labs speed up Ebola testing in eastern DR Congo
summary: In the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a mobile lab has been operating for two weeks, a welcome relief to staff at the nearby Ebola treatment centre who said that getting a test result used to take 72 hours.
author: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)
